searchText: Is there a standardized way to get the SSZ state object from the `/eth/v1/debug/beacon/states/{state_id}` (https://ethereum.github.io/eth2.0-APIs/#/Debug/getState) endpoint? Yep it’s in the Lighthouse endpoints Search for SSZ in those docs https://lighthouse-book.sigmaprime.io/api-lighthouse.html#lighthousebeaconstatesstate_idssz Oh sorry I thought this was the LH discord! This? Yep, Lighthouse only though sorry Gotcha! No worries ;P I think Teku provides this, as well I imagine this functionality would be super useful for diagnostics. Is this something that is possible to include in the standard API for all clients? Yep Teku has `/teku/v1/beacon/states/:state_id` and `/teku/v1/beacon/blocks/:block_id/state` It would be useful to add to the standard API at some point. There's a question of whether it should be a new endpoint or just use the `Accept` header - I like using the `Accept` header but don't think the endpoint to get ssz states should be under `debug`. I agree that the SSZ endpoint(s) should not be under debug. There are so many production-level things that need SSZ, some of which I have encountered are: SSV middleware and WS server There are two things there. First, I'm a fan of the idea that an `Accept` header could be used to return SSZ rather than JSON for all relevant endpoints. Second, moving `state` out of `debug` is definitely something that would be good to do, but not sure if we'll get that sorted for v1 (we already have a bit of a backlog, and it would be nice to hit mainnet with a finalised v1) I think we discussed initially, to have Accept header to determine type of response json, ssz, xml but didn't wanna add ssz in v1 to burden clients even more It's abit harder to add on endpoints which have metadata imo. Since we are missing ssz types for those What’s useful about our state SSZ endpoint is that there’s no container or anything, just pipe it to a file and you have a genesis.ssz That’s really the only time I’ve needed SSZ personally Not opposed to it though yeah, it probably makes sense for block endpoint also? I can’t see an immediate use for it, but it does seem useful Perhaps when we get into phase 1 and start having consensus issues again I think it's super useful for having a composable software stack. Can't imagine the SSZ endpoint (or even the state JSON ones) being useful to normal users by themselves. (not a priority though!)
